passiveEffects.name: Volt Absorb
passiveEffects.originalDescription: Gain an electric charge when receiving damage, converting a portion of that damage into additional Attack. Gains 8% of damage received as bonus Attack for 4s (maximum 200 bonus Attack from 2,500 damage received).
passiveEffects.summary: Gain an electric charge when receiving damage, converting a portion of that damage into additional Attack. Gains 8% of damage received as bonus Attack for 4s (maximum 200 bonus Attack from 2,500 damage received).
notes: timing, stacking overflow, refresh behavior, and rounding are unconfirmed unless explicitly stated

moveEffects.name: Slash
moveEffects.originalDescription: Pounce at an enemy and attack with sharp claws. This move's final attack throws enemies. Pounces toward the designated opposing Pokémon's location and attacks with 3 sharp claw swipes, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and throwing those hit by the last swipe for 0.5s.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Plasma Gale
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Unleash a blast of lightning, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and throw them. This also creates a zone of plasma that increases the user's basic attack range and damage dealt while inside this zone. Becomes unstoppable for 0.5s and launches a bolt of lightning toward the designated target; damaging opposing Pokémon in its path toward the target and throwing them for 0.5s. Once the bolt reaches the target; damages opposing Pokémon in an area of effect and throws them once again. Creates a circular zone of plasma centered on the target's location for 5s when it hits; paralyzing opposing Pokémon inside it for 3s. While in the zone, also increases the user's auto attack range, and auto attack damage by 20%. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 20% Attack Speed, 15% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
